pace08.about: NO EFFECT (A/B France-England 2026-11-16, 20 min each: off-ball median 3.4 without, 4.1 with; fast share 24-26 % vs 27-29 %; real 2.0). Off-ball pace test (2026-11-16): a player going to his formation place in attack (state 7, mode 0x08) has the speed he aims for capped at 0x600 + |dx| + |dz| to his target +0x6C/+0x70 (about 1100 units per m/s: some 3 m/s at 5 m, 4 m/s at 10 m, free beyond 20 m), so that he walks or jogs to a near place instead of sprinting. Hook at 0x4D34F5 (not 0x4D34F3: 0x4D34D0 jumps to 0x4D34F5, a hook over it crashed the game), where the movement code holds the speed aimed at in EDI before writing +0x1C (0x4D358A, 0x4D35FD, 0x4D3612); cave in 0xCC padding at 0x5E2920 (the cap's base is the dword at 0x5E2950). A first version capped +0x1C in mode08_positioning (0x619D77): no effect, the movement code writes the speed again afterwards.

pace09.about: PARTLY WORKS (A/B France-England 2026-11-16: jogging 24 -> 13 %, walking 15 -> 23 %, median 3.2 -> 3.0 m/s, but fast (> 5.5 m/s) unchanged 23 -> 24 %: the sprinters do not take their speed through this hook; challenges won 2.3 -> 3.1 per min). Off-ball pace test 2 (2026-11-16), after pace08 had no effect (it only covered mode 0x08 and let the whole distance add to the cap): every player in state 7 (off-ball placement: modes 8, 36, 39, 7, 29, 53... together about 52 % of the off-ball samples; the modes are printed in decimal by the logs: 36 = 0x24, 39 = 0x27, 29 = 0x1D, 53 = 0x35) has the speed he aims for capped at 0x600 + (|dx| + |dz|) / 4 to his target (about 1100 units per m/s: 1.7 m/s at 5 m, 2.0 at 10 m, 2.6 at 20 m, 3.8 at 40 m), so that he walks or jogs to a near place. Same hook as pace08 (0x4D34F5, EDI = speed aimed at, cave at 0x5E2920): do not apply both, nor the take-ball patch that also uses 0x5E2920.

pace10.about: WORKS, TOO STRONG (A/B France-England 2026-11-16: median 3.2 -> 1.9 m/s, sprints 23 -> 1 %, walking 10 -> 33 %, challenges 1.8 -> 0.8; running 4-5.5 m/s 1 % vs 7-9 % real, releases 22 vs 34-40 per min: soften the 4 in the cap). Off-ball pace test 3 (2026-11-16): pace09 (hook 0x4D34F5, cap on the animation-driven speed EDI) plus a cap at the entry of move_speed_towards 0x48FEF0 (player, target speed, step: cdecl, called from 82 action routines, the run actions among them), which pace09 missed: the sprinters took their speed there. The first six bytes of 0x48FEF0 (jmp [0x44603DC], into the protection) become a jump to a cave at 0x5E2980 which, for a player in the player zone (0x3BDC980..0x3BDFD40) in state 7, lowers the target speed argument to 0x600 + (|dx| + |dz|) / 4 and then makes the original jump. Two caves, 0x5E2920 and 0x5E2980; the take-ball patch uses 0x5E2920 too: do not apply both.

runs-more.about: Forward runs test (NO EFFECT 2026-11-16, CPU A/B over 4 x 4 min each: midfielders in mode 0x0F while their side attacks 8 % -> 7 %, releases kept 85 % -> 81 %): the function 0x61DAC0 picks ONE forward runner per side (mode 0x0F, slot 0x3BCDCA9 + side) among the defenders and midfielders in mode 0x08 (roles 1-23; forwards never). Two brakes are taken off: the cap that stops any pick once func 0x496C20's count reaches max(attack level, 2) now uses at least 4 (0x61DB2D), and the last dice roll (1 in 10, 8 or 4 by the attack and response stats, 0x61E463) always passes. The per-role gates (centre-backs only at attack level 4, defensive midfielders at 3 and over, the stat tests) are kept.

tackle-180.about: Pressing challenge at 180 % (the patcher's default, both teams): reach 0xA0 -> 0x120 (cmp edi at 0x572AE8) and attempt parameter 0x50 -> 0x7F (push at 0x572AF0), as the patcher writes them without the F8 test key. Original = the game's 100 %.

defence-line.about: Higher defensive line (#23): the two fixed 0xA00 drops of the line function 0x5E1BD0 taken off. Validated in a match 2026-11-13.

speed-x2.about: Game speed x2: frame step 0x3BE1740 = 60 / X with X = 30 (byte 0x3BE14B0), float 0x3BE12AC = X * 256 / 60. 1.5 worked in a match 2026-11-05. The game writes them back when the speed is set again, so pes6r ab re-applies it each phase.

take-ball-range.about: Pressing challenge reach (cmp edi,0A0h at 0x572AE8) raised from 160 to 288. Felt better 2026-11-03; the patcher scales a second limit too, so this is only part of the option.
